questions.question: How should we proceed with the RAG idea for agentic work on this repo?

options.label: Pre-study first (Recommended)
options.description: Classify the 833 surprising ripples plus a sample of the 451 negative read tags by what would have surfaced each: key lookup, grep, semantic search, or nothing. No infrastructure, small effort. Deep research happens only if the semantic share turns out material.

options.label: Deep research, history only
options.description: Skip the pre-study and research semantic retrieval for precedent recall over decision logs, traces, research and BACKLOG-DONE.md (about 2.85M tokens). Binding docs stay on keyed lookup. Risk: we research a mechanism before knowing how often precedent recall actually fails.

options.label: Deep research, binding docs
options.description: Research RAG over specs, ADRs and authority docs as you proposed. Widest scope and cost. It must solve exhaustiveness, amendment chains and per-branch index staleness, and the current data does not show finding binding docs as the dominant failure.

options.label: No RAG, extend keyed lookup
options.description: Drop the RAG idea. Instead file a backlog item to extend sdd_lookup.py with spec-clause and ADR-amendment-chain lookup, and close BK-420's measurement first. Deterministic and cheap, but leaves the unkeyed history corpus unsearchable by meaning.

questions.question: How should we proceed with the RAG idea for agentic work on this repo?
The pre-study found binding docs are 9.5% of 833 surprising ripples and half are code/config dependents, so RAG over binding docs looks unjustified. What should happen with this result?

options.label: Close it, no record (Recommended)
options.description: Treat the question as decided: no deep research on RAG for binding docs. Nothing is committed. The evidence is proxy-level, which is enough for a no-go but thin for a durable repo document. Risk: the question may be re-asked later without this derivation at hand.

options.label: Record a short research note
options.description: I write a concise note under sdd/research/ with the figures, their derivations and the limits, on the session branch. The negative finding survives and is citable, at the cost of one more document to keep accurate, and it rests on a path-kind proxy.

options.label: Harden with per-diff sample
options.description: Classify a fixed-seed sample of about 100 ripple entries against their PR diffs: would a key lookup, grep, semantic search or nothing have surfaced each. Medium effort with subagents and noticeable token spend. Turns the proxy into a direct measurement before anything is concluded.

options.label: Probe precedent recall
options.description: Leave binding docs on keyed lookup and test the one corpus where semantic search could fit: take about 20 past decision questions and check whether grep over decision logs, traces and BACKLOG-DONE.md finds the earlier ruling. A poor grep hit rate would justify a narrow deep research on history only.
